structure.layout: single-column marketing landing page: sticky top nav with mega-menu dropdowns, full-viewport hero with 3-column split (headline+CTAs, centered triangle logo mark, hover-expanding capability list) and a logo strip; three alternating left/right customer showcase sections (headline, large product mock, customer quote + feature list); 'Recently shipped' bento card grid; centered final CTA; 6-column directory footer

aesthetics.typography: GeistSans for all headings, body and UI (display headings at weight 400–450 with tight negative tracking). Geist Mono for small technical accents ('v0' link, 'ALL SYSTEMS NORMAL.' status line).
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong display/UI contrast: H1 64px/400, section H2s 56px/450, quotes 24px, body/buttons 16px/500, nav and footer links 14px, labels 11–13px. Display text is light rather than bold.

notes: Near-monochrome Vercel/Geist look: off-white #fafafa page, near-black #171717 type and primary buttons, and only a hint of blue (the status dot and the Backends card corner). The hero is anchored by a huge solid black triangle centered between the left-aligned headline and a right-aligned capability list. Primary CTAs are fully rounded pills (black filled plus white with a hairline shadow ring), while nav buttons and cards use 6px radii. Customer showcases alternate headline alignment left/right and use greyscale, faded-out mock UIs of customer products (Notion AI chat, Zapier site, Mintlify docs), each with a two-tone quote ('Notion powers millions' dark, rest grey) and a 'Features' list. Much of the lower page (Mintlify mock, Recently shipped bento, final CTA, footer) did not render in the static capture because of scroll-reveal animations; it was verified on the live page. Footer: 12 link columns in a 6-col grid, 'New' pills, a mono 'ALL SYSTEMS NORMAL.' status line with a blue dot, a theme segmented switch, and a 'View as AI agent' button. The capture has no codebook entry for the customer logo strip (social proof). A proposal was filed for a hover toggle on accordion.
